sourceCommon.provenance: Exact snapshot supplied by root: adult-diagnostic-qa-run-a1/after-full.json; independently pinned relevant sources below

scope: Req26 section3 local adult redacted diagnostic export. Implementing local OS save does not require support operators, SLA, routing or Auth delivery from req155.
findings: SupportDiagnosticsPanel.tsx:34-53 always Blob/objectURL/anchor.download; true means only no synchronous click exception. No native-save call or result.
App.tsx:3578 mounts the same panel in native adult settings. PlatformServices ports.ts:40-62 has no file-save/share port.
Capacitor core/android/ios 8.5.1. No Filesystem/Share dependency. Native custom plugin registrations contain ContentStore, SecureStore and Child.
Bundled Android Bridge.java:409-410 leaves blob/data inside WebView. No DownloadListener/setDownloadListener in bundled Capacitor Android or application Java sources.

Bundled iOS WebViewDelegationHandler.swift:107-124 hands external top-level navigation to UIApplication.open and cancels. No WKDownload/destination delegate in bundled Capacitor iOS or application Swift sources.

Existing Android Vault:4339-4368 and Swift Vault:9023-9035/9082 system export is private child-data custody bound to export-child-data, profileId and literary-planet-child-personal-data schema. It is not a diagnostics API.
supportDiagnosticSession.ts:59 currently bounds UTF-16 string.length. New native transport must enforce actual UTF-8 bytes.
qualification: Missing integrated native transport is confirmed by source inspection. Installed Android/iOS WebView, system picker, storage provider and file lifecycle behavior was not observed. Synthetic-platform browser downloads are not native OS acceptance.
nextOriginalPlanAction: Implement and wire dedicated adult-only Android/iOS diagnostic-save with current native adult lease, action-time consent, exact reviewed closed-JSON bytes at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes, fixed literary-planet-diagnostics.json filename, one-use bounded OS picker custody, asynchronous saved/cancelled/error result and cleanup. Preserve private child export. No NoOp/unsupported button substitute.
